functions.plate_comment: Sets core byte +0x271 to 1 between memory barriers. Source diagnostic SetNeededToRecoverLastMap. This blocks last-map saves through MapFlowSaveGridState. Relationship to RoboController need_recover_map configuration key is not established.
functions.name: MapFlowSetRecoverLast

functions.plate_comment: Clears core byte +0x271 between memory barriers; diagnostic ResetNeededToRecoverLastMap. Called only after successful persistence restore for native flag 1 in LoadSLAMMap, also from clear-map state.
functions.name: MapFlowClearRecoverLast

functions.plate_comment: Clears observed bytes/word core+0x270/+0x274, then calls clear-recover-last (+0x271); offsets are observations, not an original C++ layout.
functions.name: MapFlowClearMapState

functions.plate_comment: Flag 1 refuses saving when manager+0x1f or core+0x271 is set. Otherwise grid-save wrapper 0x1a60c4 runs first; on success stores catalog current flag as manager stored flag for destination 1, or destination flag for >1. Then captures shared poses and metadata/config (0x1a7488 under core+0x2e0 lock) and returns one. No PersistSaveMapInfo here.
functions.name: MapFlowSaveGridState

functions.plate_comment: Under core+0x2c8 lock, calls MapFlowSaveGridState sequentially for destination flags; after first false, later entries are skipped. Only if all grid stages succeed calls PersistSaveMapInfo(vector). If that call returns false, deletes grids via SLAM virtual +0x70 for every destination; errors from deletes are ignored. No rollback of already-written grids on an earlier grid-stage failure. Persistence success is API acceptance, not proof background writes finished.
functions.name: MapFlowSaveMaps

functions.plate_comment: Under core+0x2c8 lock: grid/state save first, then one-element PersistSaveMapInfo vector. Persistence false triggers grid delete via virtual +0x70; returns zero. No cross-file commit/durability claim.
functions.name: MapFlowSaveMap

functions.plate_comment: Grid load (0x68544) must succeed before flag reconciliation. Signed native_flag > 1 updates shared catalog current flag at 0x68556; flag 1 uses manager byte +0x22 and saved flag +0x28 (0x687aa..0x687fa). Then per-map/config updates precede PersistLoadMapInfo at 0x685ba. Persistence failure returns zero without undoing grid/current flag/config changes. Success restores poses and downstream state before common unlock/resume cleanup. Locks core+0x2c8 and manager mutex from 0x170850 when threading enabled; no cross-file transaction or disk-write completion implied. Third argument is a mode, not a reconstructed C++ field.
functions.name: MapFlowLoadSLAMMap
functions.signature: int MapFlowLoadSLAMMap(void *core, int native_flag, unsigned int load_mode)

functions.plate_comment: Task captures core at capture+0x10, native flag at +8 and request words at +0/+4. Calls LoadSLAMMap(core,flag,1) at 0x69076 and stores its result in completion capture+0x2c; completion callback pointer is read from vtable-like data 0x304b78 -> Thumb 0x683e1, which lacks baseline function/disassembly. Does not itself send a network reply.
functions.name: MapFlowLoadTask

functions.plate_comment: NavCore initialization includes clearing core+0x271 at instruction 0x70756. Most object layout and constructor ABI are unknown; no layout type inferred. See bounded recovery-state findings for consumers of this byte.

Calls LoadSLAMMap(core,-2,1), then SaveMap(core,1), then SetSharedCurrentMapFlag(saved manager word +0x30); load/save returns are ignored here. Capture and original task signature are not reconstructed.
functions.name: MapFlowFallbackLoadTask

functions.plate_comment: Loads catalog current flag only under the lab/use-new-map gating branches, after signed current>=2 check. Calls LoadSLAMMap at 0x83b8a; failure switches reset state rather than restoring old grid/current flag. Initializes shared dock/robot poses after this branch. Not the missing OnStateLoadLastMap function.
functions.name: MapFlowStartupMapSelect

functions.plate_comment: Returns unsigned byte at manager+0x22. Constructor 0x1a6374 clears it; MapFlowSetStoredFlag sets it. This is an in-process initialized/stored-flag predicate, not a catalog lookup or a proven persisted-file flag.
functions.name: MapFlowHasStoredFlag

functions.plate_comment: Stores byte 1 at manager+0x22 and native_flag at manager+0x28, then logs. No file write in this function. Called after grid-save success and during flag-1 reconciliation.
functions.name: MapFlowSetStoredFlag

functions.plate_comment: Returns word at manager+0x28; constructor initializes it to -1. Read during flag-1 load reconciliation.
functions.name: MapFlowGetStoredFlag

functions.plate_comment: Calls SLAM interface virtual slot +0x6c with native flag; returns one iff result code equals zero. This wrapper alone does not establish disk durability.
functions.name: MapFlowGridSave

functions.plate_comment: Calls SLAM interface virtual slot +0x68 with native flag (0x1a6236), preserves result code, returns one iff result code equals zero. Unsigned result<4 selects logging text, not success. Target implementation is outside this annotation ownership.
functions.name: MapFlowGridLoad

functions.plate_comment: Initializes observed relocation-config manager state: byte +0x22=0, word +0x28=-1, word +0x30=-1. Other fields/layout and original constructor signature intentionally unreconstructed. Calls lab-status initialization 0x1a6064.
functions.name: MapFlowInitRelocCfg

functions.plate_comment: Warmup/local-relocation state callback: if relocation did not succeed and state+0x321 or +0x322 is set, marks +0x324 and calls SetNeededToRecoverLastMap(core) at 0x20c500; successful relocation clears map/recovery state. Original ABI has register/stack decompiler uncertainties, so signature intentionally unchanged.
